title: Canonical pro-etale coefficient projection for direct image
statement:
Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\phi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism, and $f:T\to X$ a morphism of schemes. Use the ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived operations on the original small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $S_W:D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ for the derived extension of constant coefficients [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension], and $f_R^*\dashv Rf_{*,R}$ for $R=A,B$. For $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ define
$$c_{f,K}:S_X(Rf_{*,A}K)\longrightarrow Rf_{*,B}(S_TK)$$
as the unique map whose transpose under the $B$-coefficient geometric adjunction is
$$f_B^*S_X(Rf_{*,A}K)\xrightarrow{\theta}S_T f_A^*(Rf_{*,A}K)\xrightarrow{S_T(\varepsilon_{A,K})}S_TK.$$
Here $\theta$ is the canonical pullback/scalar-extension comparison: on K-flat cochain representatives it is induced by ordinary scalar balancing, as normalized in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Equivalently the map is fixed by extending the $A$-counit and transposing it, with all scalar actions retained. This is a definition for arbitrary $K$, without an invertibility assertion, coefficient finiteness, boundedness, constructibility or flatness hypothesis.
